comparisons.peer_topic: FASB ASU 2023-09 Income Tax Disclosure Improvements
comparisons.peer_summary: The FASB issued ASU 2023-09 in December 2023, requiring disaggregated income tax paid disclosures and standard categories for effective tax rate reconciliations, effective for fiscal year 2025 with early adoption permitted; the Company is currently evaluating these income tax disclosures.
comparisons.comparison: Both NVIDIA and AMD disclose the adoption timeline for the same FASB standard regarding income tax disclosures (ASU 2023-09). NVIDIA states it expects to adopt the standard in its fiscal year 2026 annual period, while AMD notes the standard is effective for its fiscal year 2025. Both companies are currently evaluating the impact of this specific income tax disclosure standard on their consolidated financial statements.

sentences.text: In December 2023, the FASB issued a new accounting standard which provides for new and changes to income tax disclosures including disaggregation of the rate reconciliation and income taxes paid disclosures.
We expect to adopt this standard in our annual period beginning fiscal year 2026.
We are currently evaluating the impact of this standard on our Consolidated Financial Statements.

In December 2023, the FASB issued ASU 2023-09 Income Taxes (Topic 740) Improvements to Income Tax Disclosures that requires disclosure of disaggregated income taxes paid, prescribes standard categories for the components of the effective tax rate reconciliation, and modifies other income tax-related disclosures.
This ASU is effective for the Company's fiscal year 2025.
The Company is currently evaluating income tax disclosures related to its annual report for fiscal year 2025.

peer_results.rationale: The disclosed topics relate to the general methodology for accounting for income taxes (asset and liability method) and a generic reference to notes, rather than the specific adoption of new FASB income tax disclosure standards (ASU 2023-09) that is the focus of the target disclosure.

The disclosed topics concern specific balances of current and long-term tax positions and the audit report of financial statements, rather than the disclosure of upcoming adoption of new FASB income tax accounting standards.

The disclosed topic concerns the adoption of a new standard for segment disclosures (ASU 2023-07), which is a different accounting update than the income tax disclosure standard (ASU 2023-09) identified in the target disclosure.
